description: The second regular session of the 75th General Assembly started on January 14, 2026. This year I am serving on the House Finance and the Business Affairs & Labor committees. With every bill that comes before the House, I am dedicated to supporting proposals that will better the lives of people in Highlands Ranch (House District 43) and the lives of people in Colorado.
